title: The app suddenly became useless
body: I opened the app yesterday to check how many steps I’ve taken and it told me no data available so I checked again today and it’s the same issue. I went to check the period section and everything was deleted, including my previous periods and the symptoms that I have experienced pretty much everything got deleted from the app and it showed me no data available so I deleted the app and reinstalled it again and it’s the same thing. It doesn’t even want me to put periods prediction or my activity as a shortcut. It’s not available anymore. So the app became useless for me
